Name: Lumisteria Giant Crops for Cornucopia More Crops
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod adds 8 giant crops for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url].

You can now get giant crops for :
Canola
Peanut
Shallot
Celery
Asparagus
Turmeric
Groundcherry
Basil

Unlike vanilla crops, those will require a pattern of 3*2 to have a chance to appear, aka :
XXX
XXX
Since this pattern is more flexible, they have a default chance that is, by default, lower than classic giant crops. This can be configured for each crop.

* [u]Important Note :[/u]
Regrowable giant crop[b] [/b]is [b]DISABLED [/b]by default; because vanilla behaviour is to replace the crop with the giant crop, making the crop actually disappears on harvest, even regrowable crops.
Enable them only if you are fine with the risk of a giant groundcherry replacing your groundcherry field OR if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14370]Giant Crop Tweaks[/url], as it will allows regrowable crops to actually regrow when the giant crop is harvested. (My suggestion is to use Giant Crop Tweaks, because it's cool, and allows also some extra features like giant crops anywhere!)

Thanks to 6480 for the crop art, that was used for the colors and some elements, and the permission to publish this mod.
